description.zh-CN: V4 诊所工作站：3 米木质台面、青绿色桌腿，配一台深色显示器和白色键盘。
description.en: The V4 clinic workstation: a 3 m wooden desk on teal legs with a dark monitor and a white keyboard.

usage.zh-CN: 在此开具检验/影像/病理医嘱并调阅结果；可开的检查取决于该工位放置时配置的能力（如检验、影像、病理）。
usage.en: Order investigations and review results here; which tests are available depends on the capabilities configured on this placement (e.g. lab, imaging, pathology).

prompt.zh-CN: E · 开具检查 / 调阅结果

description.zh-CN: 1.4 米诊室办公桌，左侧带三抽屉柜，桌上有文件、笔筒和电话。
description.en: A 1.4 m consulting-room desk with a three-drawer pedestal, papers, a pen cup and a phone.

usage.zh-CN: 医生问诊、书写病历和与患者面谈的桌子。
usage.en: Where the clinician sits to interview the patient, write notes and discuss the plan.

description.zh-CN: 诊室常见的木腿椅子，青绿色座面配木质靠背（V4 诊室椅风格）。
description.en: A plain consulting-room chair with a teal seat and a wooden back, in the V4 style.

usage.zh-CN: 供患者或家属就座问诊。
usage.en: Seating for a patient or relative during the consultation.

description.zh-CN: 带五星脚轮、气压升降杆和扶手的办公转椅。
description.en: A swivel task chair with a five-star caster base, gas lift and armrests.

usage.zh-CN: 工作站和护士站前的座椅。
usage.en: Seating at workstations and the nurse station.

description.zh-CN: 带脚轮和脚踏圈的可升降医用圆凳。
description.en: A height-adjustable clinic stool on casters with a foot ring.

usage.zh-CN: 检查时医生坐在床旁或操作台前使用。
usage.en: The clinician sits on it beside the couch or at a bench during examinations and procedures.

description.zh-CN: 三座连排候诊椅，蓝色座椅装在钢梁上，带扶手。
description.en: A row of three linked waiting-room seats with armrests on a steel beam.

usage.zh-CN: 候诊区患者和家属等候就诊的座位。
usage.en: Seating for patients and relatives waiting to be seen.

description.zh-CN: 带接待台面的挂号/分诊前台，内侧工作台上有电脑、打印机和电话。
description.en: A registration counter with a raised transaction ledge; the staff side holds a computer, printer and phone.

usage.zh-CN: 患者在此登记挂号、领取就诊号；前台人员可指引科室位置。
usage.en: Patients register and get a queue number here; the receptionist can direct you to departments.

description.zh-CN: 护士站工作台：外侧高台面，内侧双屏电脑、病历夹架和电话。
description.en: A nurse station with a high corridor counter and, on the staff side, two monitors, a chart rack and a phone.

usage.zh-CN: 查阅护理记录、医嘱执行和交班信息，也可在此询问护士患者情况。
usage.en: Review nursing records, medication administration and handover notes; the nurse here can update you on the patient.

description.zh-CN: 带电池、扫码枪和键盘托架的移动电子病历推车。
description.en: A computer-on-wheels EHR cart with battery base, barcode scanner and keyboard tray.

usage.zh-CN: 床旁查阅电子病历、既往检查和用药记录，并核对患者身份。
usage.en: Review the electronic record, prior results and medication history at the bedside and confirm patient identity.

description.zh-CN: V4 诊室检查床：木质床座、白色床垫、蓝色毛毯和枕头。
description.en: The V4 consulting-room couch: wooden base, white mattress, blue blanket and a pillow.

usage.zh-CN: 请患者躺下以便进行腹部、心肺等体格检查；与床上的患者交谈即可问诊和查体。
usage.en: Ask the patient to lie down for abdominal, cardiorespiratory and other examinations; talk to the patient on the couch to take a history and examine.

description.zh-CN: 1.0 × 2.2 米电动病床，床垫高约 0.6 米，带分段护栏、床头床尾板和控制面板。
description.en: A 1.0 × 2.2 m electric ward bed with ~0.6 m mattress height, split side rails, head/foot boards and a control panel.

usage.zh-CN: 住院、急诊和 ICU 患者卧床；可抬高床头、放下护栏后进行查体和床旁操作。
usage.en: Bed for ward, ED and ICU patients; raise the head, lower the rails and examine or perform bedside procedures.

description.zh-CN: 急诊转运平车：液压升降、带护栏、推把和折叠输液杆。
description.en: An emergency trolley with hydraulic height adjustment, side rails, push handle and a folding IV pole.

usage.zh-CN: 急诊接诊、复苏间和转运时供患者平卧；可直接在车上查体和处置。
usage.en: Holds the patient lying flat in the ED, resus bay or during transfer; examine and treat directly on the trolley.

description.zh-CN: 标准手动轮椅，大后轮带手推圈，前万向轮，可翻折脚踏。
description.en: A standard manual wheelchair with hand-rimmed rear wheels, front casters and flip-up footrests.

usage.zh-CN: 行动不便的患者坐轮椅就诊或转运；交谈与上肢、头颈部检查可在轮椅上完成。
usage.en: Patients with limited mobility attend or are transferred in it; history and upper-body examination can be done in the chair.

description.zh-CN: 带抽屉和柜门的病房床头柜，台面上有水杯和纸巾盒。
description.en: A ward bedside locker with a drawer and cupboard, a water cup and a tissue box on top.

usage.zh-CN: 存放患者个人物品；可查看床旁的药品、饮食和个人物品线索。
usage.en: Holds the patient's belongings; check it for bedside clues such as medicines, food or personal items.

description.zh-CN: 可升降的悬臂式床上餐桌，脚轮底座可推入床下。
description.en: A height-adjustable cantilever overbed table whose caster base slides under the bed.

usage.zh-CN: 放在患者胸前供进餐、书写或放置药杯、雾化器等物品。
usage.en: Swing it over the patient for meals, writing, or to hold medicine cups and nebuliser kit.

description.zh-CN: 带轨道支架的病床隔帘，上部为透气网眼。
description.en: A bay privacy curtain on a frame, with a breathable mesh top band.

usage.zh-CN: 查体或操作前拉上隔帘，保护患者隐私。
usage.en: Draw it before examinations or procedures to protect the patient's privacy and dignity.

prompt.zh-CN: E · 拉上 / 拉开隔帘

description.zh-CN: V4 会诊区书架：木质柜体，三层深色搁板上摆放白、紫、蓝色文件夹。
description.en: The V4 conference-area bookshelf: a wooden unit with three dark shelves of white, purple and blue binders.

usage.zh-CN: 存放指南、病例资料和参考书；可翻阅以获取背景信息（不提供病例事实）。
usage.en: Holds guidelines, case files and reference books; browse for background reading (it never adds case facts).

description.zh-CN: 上部玻璃门、下部实木门的医疗耗材柜，能看到里面的耗材盒。
description.en: A medical supply cabinet with glass upper doors showing boxed consumables and solid lower doors.

usage.zh-CN: 存放敷料、注射器、手套等一次性耗材。
usage.en: Stores dressings, syringes, gloves and other consumables.

description.zh-CN: 三门员工更衣柜，带通风百叶、把手和名牌。
description.en: A bank of three staff lockers with vents, handles and name tags.

usage.zh-CN: 员工存放个人物品和更换工作服。
usage.en: Staff keep personal belongings and change into scrubs here.

description.zh-CN: 诊室洗手池：不锈钢台盆、鹅颈龙头和肘动开关，配皂液与擦手纸。
description.en: A clinical hand-wash basin with gooseneck tap and elbow lever, soap and paper-towel dispensers.

usage.zh-CN: 接触患者前后按七步洗手法洗手。
usage.en: Wash your hands (WHO technique) before and after patient contact.

description.zh-CN: 双工位不锈钢外科刷手槽，感应龙头、膝控开关、刷子分配器和计时器。
description.en: A two-station stainless surgical scrub trough with sensor taps, knee paddles, brush dispenser and timer.

usage.zh-CN: 进入手术室前进行外科手消毒（刷手）。
usage.en: Perform the surgical hand scrub before entering the operating room.

description.zh-CN: 落地式免洗手消毒液架，带感应出液口和接液托盘。
description.en: A floor-standing alcohol hand-rub dispenser with a touch-free nozzle and drip tray.

usage.zh-CN: 进出病房或接触患者前后快速手消毒。
usage.en: Rub your hands on entering or leaving a room and before or after touching the patient.

description.zh-CN: 陶土花盆里的方块绿植（V4 树冠风格）。
description.en: A leafy plant in a terracotta pot, built like a V4 tree canopy.

usage.zh-CN: 装饰候诊区和走廊。
usage.en: Decorates waiting areas and corridors.

description.zh-CN: 圆形壁挂时钟。
description.en: A round wall clock.

usage.zh-CN: 记录给药、操作和抢救的时间点。
usage.en: Note the time of drugs, procedures and resuscitation events.

description.zh-CN: 壁挂白板，下方托盘放着白板笔和板擦。
description.en: A wall-mounted whiteboard with markers and an eraser on its tray.

usage.zh-CN: 交班、教学查房时书写要点和处理计划。
usage.en: Jot down key points and the plan during handover or teaching rounds.

description.zh-CN: V4 会诊区证据板：木框青绿色展板上钉着四张证据卡片。
description.en: The V4 case-conference evidence board: a teal board in a wooden frame with four pinned evidence cards.

usage.zh-CN: 汇总证据、提交诊断与处理判断、切换病例时期（如治疗后复评）并对照前后影像。
usage.en: Assemble the evidence, submit diagnostic and management decisions, switch case phase (e.g. post-treatment review) and compare images.

prompt.zh-CN: E · 会诊 · 提交判断

description.zh-CN: V4 解剖图谱站：发光台面上立着一个薄荷绿的人体模型。
description.en: The V4 atlas station: a mint anatomical figure standing on a glowing teal plinth.

usage.zh-CN: 打开公开人体解剖模型，按系统/器官观察相关解剖结构，辅助理解体征与影像。
usage.en: Open the public 3D anatomy model to review the relevant structures by system or organ while interpreting signs and images.

description.zh-CN: V4 疗愈花园里的合成工作台：木块台身，深色台面上有四格合成区。
description.en: The V4 healing-garden workbench: a wooden block with a dark top and a 2 × 2 crafting grid.

usage.zh-CN: 在建造园地中合成方块与装饰（游戏机制，与临床评分无关）。
usage.en: Craft blocks and decorations for the build zone (a game mechanic, not part of clinical scoring).

description.zh-CN: 三脚架式投影幕布，适用于会诊室和示教室。
description.en: A tripod projection screen for conference and teaching rooms.

usage.zh-CN: 病例讨论时投放病例摘要、影像与教学幻灯片。
usage.en: Shows the case summary, images and teaching slides during case discussion.

description.zh-CN: 带背光展示窗、按键面板和取货口的饮料零食售货机。
description.en: A drinks and snacks vending machine with a backlit window, keypad and pickup bin.

usage.zh-CN: 候诊区的便利设施；低血糖患者可以就近补充含糖饮料。
usage.en: A waiting-area amenity; a source of sugary drinks for a hypoglycaemic patient in a pinch.

description.zh-CN: 立式桶装饮水机，带冷热水龙头和接水盘。
description.en: A bottled water cooler with hot and cold taps and a drip tray.

usage.zh-CN: 为患者和员工提供饮用水；注意禁食患者不可饮水。
usage.en: Drinking water for patients and staff — remember nil-by-mouth patients must not drink.

description.zh-CN: 脚踏式生活垃圾桶，不锈钢桶身配黑色桶盖。
description.en: A pedal-operated general-waste bin with a stainless body and black lid.

usage.zh-CN: 丢弃非感染性生活垃圾；医疗废物应放入黄色医疗废物桶或锐器盒。
usage.en: For non-infectious general waste only; clinical waste goes in yellow clinical-waste bins and sharps in the sharps box.

description.zh-CN: 立架上的黄色锐器盒，橙红色盒盖带单向投入口和满线标识。
description.en: A yellow sharps container on a stand, with an orange-red one-way lid and a fill line.

usage.zh-CN: 用过的针头、刀片立即投入，切勿回套针帽；达到 3/4 满线时封盒。
usage.en: Drop used needles and blades straight in without recapping; seal it when filled to the ¾ line.

description.zh-CN: 壁挂式三格手套盒架，放置小、中、大号一次性检查手套。
description.en: A wall-mounted rack holding three boxes of disposable examination gloves (S/M/L).

usage.zh-CN: 接触血液、体液或黏膜前戴上检查手套，操作后摘除并手卫生。
usage.en: Put on gloves before contact with blood, body fluids or mucosa; remove them and clean hands afterwards.

description.zh-CN: V4 疗愈花园长椅：3 米木质座面与靠背，青绿色椅腿。
description.en: The V4 healing-garden bench: a 3 m wooden seat and backrest on teal legs.

usage.zh-CN: 供患者、家属和学员休息；可在此与陪同的患者交谈。
usage.en: A place for patients, relatives and learners to rest; you can talk to an accompanying patient here.

description.zh-CN: 花园石座灯柱，顶部为暖光灯笼。
description.en: A garden lamp post on a stone base, topped with a warm lantern.

usage.zh-CN: 照亮花园小路和救护车通道。
usage.en: Lights garden paths and the ambulance approach.

description.zh-CN: 木质指路牌，两块方向箭头牌（文字由设施标牌提供）。
description.en: A wooden fingerpost with two arrow boards (wording comes from the facility's signs).

usage.zh-CN: 指引前往门诊、急诊、花园等区域的方向。
usage.en: Points the way to the clinic, emergency department, garden and other areas.

description.zh-CN: 白色方舱式救护车，红色腰线与十字标识，车顶红蓝警灯。
description.en: A boxy white ambulance with a red stripe and cross and a red/blue roof light bar.

usage.zh-CN: 院前急救转运患者至急诊；救护车到达后在抢救区交接患者。
usage.en: Brings pre-hospital patients to the emergency department; take the paramedic handover in the ambulance bay.

description.zh-CN: 医院门口的玻璃候车亭，带长椅、站牌、时刻表和灯箱广告。
description.en: A glass bus shelter outside the hospital with a bench, stop sign, timetable and an advertising light box.

usage.zh-CN: 医院外部场景装饰，门诊患者可能在此出现。
usage.en: Scenery at the hospital entrance; outpatients may be found waiting here.
